description: The ingestion agent's four operating modes — RESEARCH, REFRESH, INGEST-MEDIA, FOLLOW-A-SOURCE — graded against a frozen mini-web and a frozen scratch memory corpus.
notes: Every task here is a rail from the agent's own system prompt or a real incident. Tasks 1-3 grade the memory-write half (distillation, update-in-place, tag hygiene); tasks 4-6 grade the media half (source vs single video, already-ingested honesty, the do-NOT-chunk-a-short-transcript rule from migration 036). The tech-news-digest automation also runs as this agent, but its digest behavior is graded in the news-summarizer suite because that is where the digest corpus lives. v2: web_search and fetch_url joined replay_only_tools — the four media/tag tasks grant them but author no fixture, so a stray call used to reach nothing and invalidate the whole run; now it is served the replay-only default and costs a graded tool_error (three of those tasks also name them in must_not_call). The two research tasks are unaffected: their fixtures are matched before the default. Recording NEW web fixtures for this suite means temporarily removing them from this list — replay-only means never execute, in record mode too.

run.replay_only_default: Error: this tool is not available in eval replay mode.
